$comment: Committed registration. The W7 D5 agent reads this at startup to learn the surface before
it connects, so the four tool names, the resource URI and the version must match what the
server actually publishes - tests/test_tool_descriptions.py asserts exactly that, because a
registration that drifts from the server is worse than none: it is a contract a client
trusts and the server does not honour.
No credential appears here. The stdio launcher reads its bearer from the environment and
the SSE entry declares only the auth SCHEME, not a token.
name: taxcalc-mcp-server
description: MCP surface for taxcalc-orders, llm-proxy, and the W7 D3 RAG pipeline.
